message.content:
This editorial illustration, a magazine cover for "TEMPO" dated "30 SEPTEMBER-6 OKTOBER 2019," features several figures against a dark, shadowy background. In the center, a seated man with light skin, closed eyes, and a somber expression wears a white short-sleeved shirt and black pants. A large, dark pair of hands rests firmly on his shoulders. To his left, a person in a yellow jacket and black pants stands with their back to the viewer, holding a grey megaphone in their right hand. This person wears black and white low-top sneakers. To the center man’s right, another man in a white long-sleeved shirt and black pants stands looking down, wearing red, white, and black high-top sneakers.

Behind these figures, large, dark legs and torsos in formal suits loom, filling the background. The text "TERSUDUT MILENIAL" is superimposed across the center in large white letters. Smaller white text below it begins with "DIKEPUNG DEMONSTRASI MENOLAK PELEMAHAN KOMISI PEMBERANTASAN KORUPSI." Additional headlines at the top read "PECAH KONGSI GARUDA DAN SRIWIJAYA" and "ORANG POLITIK DI BPK." The composition is vertically oriented with a prominent red "TEMPO" masthead.
